claim: Diagnose SR-module fidelity separately from native low-resolution generation. Prompt-only method/budget routing benefit remains unproven.
adaptations: Use the author's v1.1 Tiny model, LCSA backend and inference parameters; no RGB-SR-to-VAE-to-HR4 stage.
Pad LR right/bottom with edge pixels to multiples of 32 before bicubic x4; remove padding, never center-crop source content.
Repeat the last frame to a sufficient 8n+1 input length; trim only padded output frames, never shorten the source prefix.
Native LR uses official x4 followed by Lanczos resizing to the original FULL canvas; this is not a native x2 recipe.
Fixed first 33 frames by default; screening only, not a complete-video quality or speed claim.
